spec_match.rationale: Converts real RWS manifest fields into per-domain CHIPS Set-Cookie headers (Partitioned; SameSite=None; Secure) and feature-detects the exact Storage Access surfaces the removal touches.

interactive.rationale: Editable manifest, convert button, three presets (simple / service sites / ccTLDs), per-domain comparison cards, and a live feature-detect panel.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the index card (filename corrected to the spec's singular related-website-set.json in both card and page).

edge_cases.rationale: JSON parse errors and invalid primary URLs render explicit errors (exercised via CDP); the detect panel distinguishes not-yet-removed from removed and version-gates its summary at 153 instead of the predecessor's 150.

references.rationale: Links ChromeStatus feature 5194473869017088 and MDN CHIPS.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level v153 suite asserts the removal/survivor contract; the privacy comparison table's claims were re-checked (Firefox/Safari partition-by-default framing replaces the vague 'partial/planned').

runtime_evidence.rationale: Feature harness run passed desktop+mobile (screenshots read). CDP sweep converted all three presets (3 and 5 domain cards), read the detect grid ('present (removal rollout not reached)' on this Chrome 141 headless build — honest), and confirmed the bad-JSON error path; zero console errors/exceptions/failed requests.

telemetry_health.rationale: Shared demo-telemetry shell active; conversion and detection results are explicit text.

design_system.rationale: Design-system variables only; role badges override background and color together; escapeHtml covers &, <, >, quotes for user-pasted domain strings.

accessibility.rationale: Textarea accessible name fixed to 'Related website set manifest JSON'; detect rows carry title notes and textual status; cards are plain text content.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Feature harness passed both classes; comparison columns stack at 15rem basis and the privacy table fits without page-level overflow.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive migration wizard step tabs without horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Comparison columns should wrap to a single stack on narrow viewports via flex-basis, never force horizontal scrolling of the page.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: col-rws/col-chips keep flex: 1 1 15rem so cards stack on mobile; code blocks scroll internally with overflow-x auto.

summary: v153 refile of rws-to-chips-migrator. Fixes vs the predecessor: well-known filename corrected to the spec's singular form, the UA version gate moved from 150 to 153 with stepped-rollout wording, detect-panel labels made honest for not-yet-removed installs, and the browser-support row of the privacy table re-grounded (Chrome/Edge 114+; Firefox/Safari partition by default). Verified via the responsive harness and a full CDP sweep with zero console errors.
